0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b → KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ≤ 1 →
KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b (KdVPlan.err τ f v) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.err τ f v)) ∧
KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (KdVPlan.err τ f v) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.err τ f v)) ≤ C*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)

intro M hM
rcases @yui_aux_0124 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M hM with ⟨Cr,hCr,hRl⟩
rcases h_T005.1.1 with ⟨B,hB,hi,hm,hBB,hJ⟩
let D := B*(M+1)+Cr
have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by linarith
have hD : 0 < D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
refine ⟨1+D,by positivity,?_⟩
intro τ L f v a b hτ hτ1 htr hg hE
have hh := @yui_aux_0120 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v a b hτ htr hg
have hE0 := hh.2.2.2.2.1
have hq0 : 0 ≤ τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v := add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le _) hE0
have hr := hRl τ L f v a b hτ hτ1 htr hg hE
have hrAE0 := @yui_aux_0108 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b _ hr.1
have hrAE : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)), KdVPlan.HB (-KdVPlan.pstar) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.residual τ f) t) (Cr*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)) :=
  hrAE0.mono (fun t ht => ⟨ht.1,ht.2.trans hr.2⟩)
rcases @yui_aux_0114 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ L hτ with ⟨p,hp⟩
have hae : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)), KdVPlan.HB (-KdVPlan.pstar) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.err τ f v) t) (D*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)) := by
  rw [← restrict_Ioo_eq_restrict_Icc] at hrAE ⊢
  have hpn : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Ioo a b)), t ∉ (p : Set ℝ) :=
    ae_mono Measure.restrict_le_self (p.finite_toSet.countable.ae_notMem volume)
  filter_upwards [hrAE,hpn,ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo] with t hrt htp hti

  have htG : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ((L : ℝ)*τ) := ⟨hg.1.trans_lt hti.1,hti.2.trans_le hg.2.2.1⟩
  have hcell := hp t ⟨htG.1.le,htG.2.le⟩ htp
  have he := hh.2.2.2.1 t htc
  have hv := hh.2.2.2.2.2.1 t htc
  have hse := (@yui_aux_0068 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).2.1 0 _ (1/2) _ he
  have hhalf : ‖(1/2 : ℂ)‖=(1/2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  rw [hhalf] at hse
  have hgb := ((@yui_aux_0068 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).1 0 _ _ _ _ hv hse).2
  have hgB : KdVPlan.HB 0 (v t-KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.err τ f v t)) (M+1) :=

  have hBt := (hBB t _ _ he.1 hgB.1).1
  have he0 : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.err τ f v t) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hg0 : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (v t-KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.err τ f v t)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hBn : B*KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.err τ f v t)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (v t-KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.err τ f v t)) ≤ B*KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v*(M+1) := by gcongr; exact he.2; exact hgB.2
  have hBbound : KdVPlan.HB (-KdVPlan.pstar) (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.err τ f v t) (v t-KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.err τ f v t))) (B*KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v*(M+1)) := ⟨hBt.1,hBt.2.trans hBn⟩
  rw [@yui_aux_0129 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v hτ htr _ t hcell.2 htG]
  have hb := ((@yui_aux_0068 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).1 _ _ _ _ _ hBbound hrt).2
  refine ⟨hb.1,hb.2.trans ?_⟩

  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq (show 0 ≤ B*(M+1) by positivity)
  dsimp [D]
  nlinarith only [hmul]
have hdiff := (@yui_aux_0131 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v a b hτ htr hg).2
have hdiffE : ∃ p : Finset ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, t ∉ p → ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.err τ f v r k) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.err τ f v) t k) t := by
  rcases hdiff with ⟨p,hp⟩
  exact ⟨p,fun t ht htp k => (hp t ht htp k).2⟩
have hx := @yui_aux_0130 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 a b (KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v) (D*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)) (KdVPlan.err τ f v) hg.2.1 hE0 (mul_nonneg hD.le hq0) hh.2.2.1 hh.2.2.2.1 hdiffE hae
refine ⟨hx.1,hx.2.trans ?_⟩
have hτg : 0 ≤ τ^gamma := Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le _
nlinarith only [hτg]
